verdict.rationale: Docs show real dedup/noise-reduction mechanisms (reading existing PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions, custom BUGBOT.md guidelines, verbose mode showing which rules ran, configurable effort/depth) but no mention of severity labels anywhere in the evidence. Community reports are split: some engineers call it 'pretty good' with 'almost none of its comments frivolous or wrong,' while others report it was 'subtly wrong,' argued against its own correct fixes, and had to be switched from auto-review to request-only mode — concrete hands-on contradiction of the low-noise claim. missing for 10: severity labeling feature, independent quantitative false-positive-rate data, resolution of the conflicting community reports.
